backendConnectionPolicy: The public website is a static marketing and information surface. It must not call business APIs directly or expose backend/provider credentials. Dynamic business state and all privileged actions remain backend-owned through the authenticated apps.
requiredBeforePublishing: Verify official Admin URL before configuring adminUrl.
Verify official Google Play URL before configuring androidUrl.
Verify official Apple App Store URL before configuring iosUrl.
Keep all unconfigured destinations disabled and never invent a URL.
Verify the test-period notice and service claims with authorized project owners.
Perform keyboard, mobile responsive and browser smoke tests.
rules: No direct fetch, XMLHttpRequest, axios, WebSocket or EventSource calls from the public website.
No localhost or loopback endpoints in shipped website files.
Configured outbound destinations must be absolute HTTPS URLs with a hostname and without embedded username/password.
Do not infer service availability from static marketing content; backend confirmation is authoritative.
Do not display OTPs, tokens, provider secrets or private keys on the public website.
Unknown download/admin destinations stay disabled until approved.
runtimeVerification: Static source checks only; browser and production-host smoke tests remain pending.
